subject.title: acp: assistant text corrupted when Gateway revises in-progress output (non-append revision mis-sliced)

question: What ACP-visible behavior should OpenClaw use when Gateway marks an in-progress assistant snapshot as a non-append replacement?
rationale: Gateway already emits `replace: true` and full `deltaText`, but ACP session updates observed in OpenClaw are append-style chunks, so choosing the representation affects every ACP client and should not be guessed by automation.

options.title: Confirm and prove linked PR semantics
options.body: Treat a replacement delta as a full fresh chunk only if real ACP clients render the authoritative final text, then land or narrowly rework https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102569.

options.title: Define reset or replay semantics first
options.body: Hold the fix until maintainers define an ACP-compatible clear/replay/edit path for already-rendered assistant text.

options.title: Limit support to append-only ACP streaming
options.body: Document that non-append Gateway revisions are not supported through ACP and close the candidate PR if maintainers accept stale/corrupt intermediate output as out of scope.

recommendation.title: Confirm and prove linked PR semantics
recommendation.body: Treat a replacement delta as a full fresh chunk only if real ACP clients render the authoritative final text, then land or narrowly rework https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102569.

likelyOwner.reason: The ACP bridge originated in his commits and he has the broadest relevant history across ACP and Gateway chat streaming.
